_comment: copyleft-license is disabled deliberately, not to hide a finding. Every
package it flags is base-image OS userland (busybox, alpine-baselayout,
musl-utils, ssl_client) — unremovable without abandoning Alpine, and worse
on Debian (369 packages on the backend). Copyleft obligations attach to
DISTRIBUTION; these images run privately on our own box and are never
shipped to third parties. If that ever changes — public images, or handing
a build to someone else — re-enable this and do a real license review.
Nothing else is disabled: CVEs, non-root, base-image freshness and
